name: M3 MRAD
notes: FFP, cam kazıma ('ETCHED GLASS M3 MRAD RETICLE'). Sayfa: 'a precise .1 Mil floating donut that acts as your aiming point', 'providing 4 Mils of hold-under', 'Your main crosshairs feature 0.2 Mil increments with 0.5 Mil markings at the center of each segment', 'Wind holds are spaced in 1 Mil increments up to 8 Mils' -> hash_step=0.2, extent_v_down=4, extent_h=8, floating_center=true. Merkez nokta değil içi boş halka (donut) -> center_dot null. Üst yarı 'wide-open' (sayı yok) -> extent_v_up null. Döküm tablosu harf eşlemesi görselde. Kaynak: https://www.leapers.com/products-integrix-ix801fm3.html (okundu 2026-10-12)
